title: Yellow Rich Ethiopian Cabbage Berbere Stew
description: A rich and chewy Ethiopian dish featuring hispi sweetheart cabbage, made with a double-fry method and berbere spice, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This nut-free friendly stew is a hearty and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to wilt, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir the stew occasionally to prevent scorching.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
